correctness.rationale: For positive nonuniform iid base-q digits, cylinder widths U_w=q^-n and masses P_w give L_n=Σsqrt(U_w²+P_w²), so ∆_n=ΣU_w[1+P_w/U_w-sqrt(1+(P_w/U_w)²)]. Rationalization gives (2-sqrt2) overlap<=∆_n<=overlap where overlap=1-TV(P^n,U^n). A Chernoff product tilt with zero mean bounds overlap between Z^n and exp(-O(sqrt n))Z^n, giving exponential root Z. In binary, the exact tilted binomial average with α=-log(2(1-p))/log(p/(1-p)) admits dominated uniform lattice local limit with periodic H_p({nα}); two integrations by parts yield nonzero beta-function Fourier coefficients. For p=.9, α=log5/log9 irrational, giving nonconvergent normalized arclength and exact cluster interval. Independently recomputed p=.9 tilted sums n=40,100,250,700,2000 and nonconstant phase (range 1.5497115..1.5598788; n2000 relative error approximately -0.00257156). Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the analytic proof.
